title: Make whole questions copyable
steps: Put all descendants inside a borderless 1x1 native question table.
Map question ID to native table/control IDs; check descendant coverage.
For a required transfer behavior, use P-native-transfer and distinguish the observed HWPML2X selected-block route from unexercised OS clipboard Copy/Paste; qualify only newly required behavior.
stopWhen: Only table count exists but clipboard preservation is being claimed.
limitation: A reusable execution recipe; historical success does not certify a different source or current native environment.
